title: Potatoes: food on gravel, not bare rock
approach: Potatoes are less sensitive to fertility than rice or corn and are a useful choice on plantable gravel.
Check each proposed tile. Rough stone and sand are not interchangeable with gravel; a potato still needs the native minimum fertility.
Plant eligible patches near camp and bridge the slower harvest with safe gathering or hunting. If no tiles qualify, choose another food source rather than retrying the same invalid zone.
verify: Terrain fertility meets the crop definition; plants are actually being sown.
reconsider: No eligible land, too little growing season, or no labor to finish sowing.
